 Win a Trip to Hong Kong Disneyland at OPPO’s 11.11 Sale 
 by Josh Austria 
 November 6, 2026 
 Josh Austria 
 Aside from being a businessman, Josh Austria has been working…
 Your next tech upgrade could be the start of a magical Disney adventure! This 11.11, check off your holiday wishlist with savings of up to Php 8,000 and exclusive gifts on select OPPO devices. Shop for yourself or surprise someone special at OPPO’s official stores on Shopee , Lazada , and TikTok Shop until November 13, 2026.
 The excitement goes beyond checkout as OPPO’s Christmas campaign launches on November 11, giving eligible online participants a chance to discover the enchanting world of Hong Kong Disneyland. Imagine stepping into beloved Disney stories, meeting your favorite characters, and exploring whimsical lands filled with thrilling attractions and dazzling entertainment with your OPPO smartphone ready to capture the wonder.
 Two lucky grand prize winners will each receive a five-day, four-night Hong Kong Disneyland package worth Php 500,000, for a combined grand prize value of Php 1 Million.
 Make your wishlist go further with OPPO’s 11.11 deals 
 Give your holiday wishlist a head start! Capture festive moments with a new smartphone, switch from work to holiday movie marathons on a tablet, or take your seasonal playlist wherever you go with wireless earbuds. Score your next OPPO upgrade with these deals:
 Lazada 
 Php 1,000 off: OPPO Enco Air5, OPPO Enco Air5s, OPPO Reno15 5G, and OPPO A6t
 Php 2,000 off: OPPO Pad SE WiFi/LTE, OPPO Bubble, and OPPO A6c
 Php 3,000 off: OPPO A6s
 Php 4,000 off: OPPO Find X9
 Php 5,000 off: Reno13
 Php 6,000 off: Reno14 Pro
 Php 7,000 off: Reno12 Pro
 Php 8,000 off: OPPO Reno16 Series
 TikTok Shop 
 Php 1,000 off: OPPO Enco Air5, OPPO Enco Air5s, and OPPO Reno15 Series
 Php 2,000 off: OPPO Pad SE WiFi/LTE, OPPO A6x, OPPO A6t, and OPPO Bubble
 Php 4,000 off: OPPO Find X9
 Php 8,000 off: OPPO Reno16 Series
 Shopee 
 Php 1,000 off: OPPO Enco Air5 and OPPO Enco Air5s
 Php 2,000 off: OPPO Bubble (from November 1-10 and November 12 onwards)
 Php 4,000 off: OPPO Find X9
 Php 8,000 off: OPPO Reno16 Series (from November 1-10 and November 12 onwards)
 Unbox extra joy with exclusive gifts 
 Unbox a little extra excitement with your OPPO upgrade! Select purchases come with free gifts, including handy accessories that keep your devices protected:
 OPPO Pad SE: free OPPO Pad SE Case
 OPPO Reno16 Series: Free 10,000 mAh power bank
 OPPO Reno15 Series: free 10,000mAh power bank
 OPPO Watch S: free Watch S Strap
 OPPO A7 Pro 5G: free Tango Jet Earbuds worth Php 1,699, while stocks last
 Shoppers purchasing the OPPO A7 Pro can also enjoy Php 100 GCash cashback until December 11.
 Three Carols could take you closer to Disney magic 
 Your dream Disney getaway could be a few Carols away! Join the Maligayang PaskOPPO celebration by completing the following three Carols:
 1st Carol: Visit any participating OPPO Official Online Store and pre-register through the Maligayang PaskOPPO Digital Caroling Pass .
 2nd Carol: Purchase an eligible OPPO smartphone and link your newly purchased device to the My OPPO App to join the AGUINALDOPPO Instant Draw for a chance to win exclusive freebies or vouchers.
 3rd Carol: Share your Christmas moment by commenting on the designated Maligayang PaskOPPO thread in the My OPPO App PH Circle (O-Community).
 Each eligible My OPPO user may complete one Digital Caroling Pass and earn a maximum of one Grand Raffle entry throughout the promotion, regardless of the number of qualified purchases. Every qualified entry brings a chance to win, but does not guarantee a prize.
 Then, let the countdown begin! The Grand Raffle draw happens on January 31, 2027, with winners selected electronically in accordance with the approved DTI mechanics. Keep an eye on OPPO Philippines’ official social media pages and the My OPPO App for the announcement—you could be one of the lucky winners heading into the magic!
 More prizes to spread the holiday cheer 
 The Grand Raffle will have 1,277 winners in total, including the two Hong Kong Disneyland grand prize winners. Other prizes in the pool include:
 OPPO A3x (4GB+64GB), OPPO Reno12 Pro 5G (12GB+512GB), and OPPO A5 Pro or A6t Pro
 OnePlus Nord Buds2 and OPPO Enco Buds2 Pro
 YOOSE Nano Electric Razor and YOOSE Electric Shaver (Mini 2.0) Silver
 3,000 SMAC Points and 1,000 SMAC Points
 Php 300 Grab Voucher, Php 100 SM Gift Pass, Php 100 ShopeePay, and Php 100 GCash
 Digital vouchers must be redeemed within 60 days of the winning date, subject to applicable redemption conditions. Physical Grand Raffle prizes will be delivered to winners’ registered addresses upon successful verification.
 ‘Shop to Win’ travel luggage for your next adventure 
 There’s more holiday excitement in store for online shoppers! Whether you’re upgrading your phone or surprising someone special with a new OPPO device, your purchase could come with a travel-ready bonus.
 Happening from November 1-10, OPPO’s ‘Shop to Win’ early raffle gives 11 lucky winners a chance to receive a travel luggage for their adventures ahead. From a long-awaited homecoming to a spontaneous weekend escape, imagine packing your new device alongside your holiday essentials and setting off to make new memories. Here’s how to join:
 Customers will earn one (1) raffle entry for every purchase of any OPPO device made through the OPPO Official Store on  Shopee , Lazada , and TikTok Shop .
 The promo period runs from November 1, 2026, at 12:00 AM to November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM.
 Eleven (11) winners will each receive one (1) travel luggage.
 The raffle draw will be held on November 27, 2026. Winners will be contacted via Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop Chat and provided with instructions on how to claim their prizes.
 Start your holiday shopping with OPPO and let the season’s surprises unfold. For more information on the 11.11 Sale and Christmas campaign, visit www.oppo.com/ph/ and OPPO Philippines’ official Facebook page.
